title: Normalized derived constant-module comparison data
statement: For GeometricData $d$, ExactData $x$, OrdinaryIdentification $o$, FixedTensorData $t$ and the two normalized derived scalar comparisons [def-sfb-constant-module-geometric-comparison-data], define DerivedIdentification to consist of isomorphisms intertwining the two localized inverse images and the two right derived direct images with scalar restriction; their localization squares on all cochain complexes must recover $o$. Include DerivedTensorIdentification, the scalar-restriction tensor square, the commuting full derived Hom, unit and counit equations for the canonical K-injective adjunctions, and the counit-transpose projection square [def-sfb-derived-projection-comparison-squares]. Here all categories are ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. These are packages of specified comparisons and equations, without any existence assertion or boundedness restriction on the unbounded inputs.
